page.overview:
Who is Sehn Baroule?

Sehn Baroule was the director of Premier Provisions, a small ranch on Sprawl 34 of the planet Tyed Kant. Secretly he was also a rebel agent, operating a hidden listening post to spy on the Galactic Empire. He died when the Mynock virus caused the computer systems to go haywire, asphyxiating everyone on Sprawl 34.
